videos.title: Activating the AI Hivemind | Accenture at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Advanced AI Delivery Lead Tracy Venable reveals how Accenture and Palantir are working together to transform enterprise consulting—operationalizing decades of expertise through AI agents that compress ERP migrations from months to weeks, deliver business value from day one, and enable every engagement to build on institutional knowledge accumulated across thousands of deployments.

videos.title: ArsenalOS: Architecture from Design to Deployment | Northrop Grumman at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Rebecca Torzone, Sector Vice President and General Manager of Airborne Multifunction Sensors at Northrop Grumman, showcases ArsenalOS — the Palantir powered operating system that connects the entire value chain: from design, to supply chain, to manufacturing, and deployment to the warfighter at mission speed.

videos.title: Scaling Stratospheric Intelligence with AI | World View at AIPCon 9
videos.description:
World View CEO Ryan Hartman reveals how AI and Palantir's technology are enabling operators to manage fleets of stratospheric balloons instead of single missions—scaling operations through autonomous mission planning and multi-domain intelligence coordination.

All data shown is notional. Actual results and experiences may vary.

videos.title: Accelerating American Shipbuilding with ShipOS | U.S. Navy at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Vice Admiral Seiko Okano demonstrates how ShipOS is transforming America's maritime industrial base—using AI to orchestrate complex supply chains, optimize shipyard operations, and accelerate production from submarines to surface vessels, ensuring the U.S. Navy can build the fleet faster while empowering American workers and suppliers.

videos.title: How to Win Maximally | Ted Mabrey at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Ted Mabrey, Global Head of Commercial at Palantir, highlights the dramatic step change he is witnessing in our engagement with partners to scale and operationalize our products, explaining what has changed, why it matters, and how we are evolving our engagement model to win maximally.

videos.title: Multi-Domain AI: The Future of Command and Control | CDAO at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Cameron Stanley, Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer of the Department of War, shares how the DoW is driving enterprise-wide adoption of data, analytics, and AI to generate decision advantage—and what it takes to move cutting-edge technology from the lab to the warfighter at speed.

videos.title: Building America's Nuclear Future | Centrus Energy at AIPCon 9
videos.description: Patrick Brown shares how Centrus Energy is enabling the nuclear renaissance through Palantir— orchestrating agents across quality, procurement, and manufacturing to scale domestic uranium production with the real-time visibility and predictive action America's energy future demands.

videos.title: Replatforming Healthcare Accreditation | Joint Commission at AIPCon 9
videos.description: William Walders shares how Joint Commission partnered with Palantir to transform 75 years of ossified business systems into an intelligent operating system with bi-directional write-back, solver optimization, and agentic workflows—reducing provider burden while maintaining the highest standards for patient safety and quality.

videos.title: Software Meets Hardware: Empowering the Warfighter | GE Aerospace at AIPCon 9
videos.description:
Jess Salzbrun, CIO of GE Aerospace's Defense & Systems division, speaks to how the world's largest engine manufacturer is combining software and hardware to solve Air Force readiness challenges and ensure the engines powering tomorrow's warfighters stay mission-ready. 

The appearance of U.S. Department of Defense (DoW) visual information does not imply or constitute DoW endorsement.

videos.title: Backstage Pass | AIPCon 9
videos.description: Chad Wahlquist, Forward Deployed Architect at Palantir, goes behind the scenes at AIPCon 9, where he tours various immersive experiences showcasing Ship OS and Maven Smart System, as well as our work with Teton Ridge, Armada, TeleTracking, Carilion Clinic, and Tampa General Hospital.
